data_scope_model: DataScope { role, userId, scopeType (self|team|branch|company), territoryId?, branchId?, supervisorId? }

scope_type_meaning.self: own data + customers assigned to the rep
scope_type_meaning.team: own reps + their customers (repId === scope.userId OR rep.supervisorId === scope.supervisorId)
scope_type_meaning.branch: branch data; company-wide views preserved (e.g., routes/visits for SM)

canAccess_functions.canAccessStockTransfer: company/branch→true; else isRep(t.toRepId)  [NOTE: only receiver filtered, NOT sender]
canAccess_functions.canAccessGps: only isUser(scope,g.userId)  [NOTE: team/branch/company canNOT see team GPS unless isUser — team GPS likely broken for SUP]
canAccess_functions.canAccessTarget: company/branch→true; isUser; or team territory owner
canAccess_functions.canAccessTerritory: company/branch→true; team→own or supervisor; else own
canAccess_functions.canAccessArchive: company/branch→true; else team/self via createdBy name match

findings: CRITICAL: canAccessGps uses isUser only — for SUPERVISOR 'team' scope, users are resolved but GPS records are keyed by userId (rep); SUP viewing team GPS requires visibleUserIds to include team reps (it does) and canAccessGps to check isUser(scope, g.userId) — passes only if g.userId is in visibleUserIds. SUP team scope visibleUserIds includes team reps, so SUP CAN see team GPS. OK, but REP 'self' scope visibleUserIds = [userId, supervisorId]; canAccessGps(g.userId===rep) passes. Rep sees own GPS — correct. Verified logic OK.

Issue: canAccessStockTransfer only checks t.toRepId (receiver). Sender (toRepId) filtering only; a sender rep could see outgoing transfers they shouldn't, or rep A could see transfers addressed to rep B only (by toRepId). REP 'self' sees transfers where toRepId===self — correct for receiving. But REP-created transfers (from REP) are not filterable by sender — acceptable if sender sees via 'createdBy' elsewhere.

Issue: DO/DIST/FIN/AUD/HR all fall into default 'company' scope. A Distributor logging in would see ALL distributors' data (scopeType=company) — VIOLATION of Chapter 3 3.6/3.7.5 (DIST must see own entity only). Needs DistributorDataScope by distributorId.
Issue: DistributionOfficer uses company scope — sees all distributors' sell-in/sell-out regardless of network. Needs DO network scope (managed distributors).
Issue: Financial roles (FIN) get company scope over Customers/Invoices/Returns — Finance per Chapter 3 3.5 only needs Cash/Cost/Collections/Profitability, not edit all.
